profile.summary: A nonprofit based in Oakland that provides tutoring and supplemental education programs for students across the Bay Area. Its Community Reading Buddies program trains teens to mentor younger students in reading. It also offers test preparation and partners with schools and nonprofits on custom programs.

sources.title: Aspire Education Project - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica

review.notes: Identity is solid: the OUSD ECCCO host list names 'Aspire Education / Community Reading Buddies', and ProPublica and the website match (Oakland, EIN 20-5274459). However, the summary claims the org 'offers test preparation' and trains 'teens', and the cited site mentions neither (it describes K-6 tutoring and 'Bay Area young adults' as mentors), so the summary is not supported.
